name: New Year Print: Two Boys Presenting a Pair of Vases with Flowers
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink and color on paper; with printed shop inscription reading from right to left: "Yuan Tai" (probably the print shop name). Possibly from Xinjiang, Shanxi.
